title: Login page freezes after multiple failed attempts
description: After 3 failed login attempts the QuantumRoast web portal login page becomes unresponsive and requires a full refresh. Console shows an unhandled promise rejection in auth.js.

title: Dashboard sales widget intermittently shows zero values
description: The 'Sales Overview' widget on the main dashboard sometimes displays 0 for all metrics even though sales exist. A browser refresh fixes it. Suspect a race condition in the metrics cache warmup.

title: Broken image links on product catalog page
description: Several product images on the catalog page return 404 since the CDN migration. Affects the Espresso Pro and Barista Max product pages.

title: Incorrect order total calculation for discounts
description: Orders that combine a percentage coupon with free shipping compute the total incorrectly: the discount is applied after tax instead of before tax.

title: Mobile app crashes when brewing schedule is set past midnight
description: The QuantumRoast mobile app crashes with an IndexOutOfRange exception when a user sets a brewing schedule that spans midnight (e.g. 23:30 to 00:30). Reproducible on Android 15.

title: Firmware OTA update stuck at 99 percent
description: Smart coffee machines on firmware 4.2.1 hang at 99% during over-the-air update to 4.3.0. Device logs show a checksum mismatch on the final chunk; power cycling reverts to the old firmware.

title: Grinder calibration resets after power outage
description: Custom grind size settings are lost after a power outage. Settings are only written to volatile memory and not persisted to flash.

title: Password reset email not delivered to Outlook users
description: Customers with outlook.com addresses do not receive password reset emails. SPF record for the transactional mail domain is missing an include.

title: Water tank level sensor reports empty when full
description: On Barista Max units manufactured in July, the water level sensor reports 'tank empty' even when the tank is full. Appears to be an inverted ADC reading in sensor driver v2.

title: Typo in checkout confirmation message
description: The checkout confirmation page says 'Your oder has been placed'. Should be 'order'.

title: Subscription renewal charges customers twice
description: A retry in the billing worker causes coffee bean subscription renewals to be charged twice when the payment gateway responds slowly (>10s). Idempotency key is not sent.

title: Slow search on recipes page
description: Searching recipes takes 6-8 seconds. The query does a full table scan on recipes.ingredients; an index is missing.

title: Machine Wi-Fi pairing fails on 5GHz networks
description: Smart machines cannot pair with routers broadcasting only 5GHz. The Wi-Fi module supports 2.4GHz only but the app does not warn the user.

title: Dark mode text unreadable in settings screen
description: In the mobile app settings screen, dark mode renders dark grey text on a black background.
